final_message: Updated `grammar/precedence.ebnf` so the exponent rule reflects that unary (level 70) actually binds tighter than exponent (level 60): `exponent` now uses `unary` operands instead of bare `atom`, and the example label was corrected to `unary-binds-before-exponent` to match the stated precedence levels. The `unary` rule itself is unchanged.

example = unary-binds-before-exponent
